mapper.sql: c.id, c.course_name, c.position_id, c.course_type, c.is_required, c.cover_url, c.intro, c.status, c.published_at, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.deleted, p.position_name, (SELECT d.dept_name FROM dept_position dp_name INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = dp_name.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' WHERE dp_name.position_id = c.position_id AND dp_name.status = 1 ORDER BY dp_name.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM course_chapter cc WHERE cc.course_id = c.id AND cc.deleted = 0) AS chapter_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM study_item si INNER JOIN course_chapter cc_item ON cc_item.id = si.chapter_id AND cc_item.deleted = 0 WHERE cc_item.course_id = c.id AND si.deleted = 0) AS item_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.user_id) FROM study_record sr INNER JOIN sys_user learned_user ON learned_user.user_id = sr.user_id AND learned_user.del_flag = '0' AND learned_user.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE') INNER JOIN dept_position learned_scope ON learned_scope.dept_id = learned_user.dept_id AND learned_scope.position_id = c.position_id AND learned_scope.status = 1 WHERE sr.course_id = c.id) AS student_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT expected_user.user_id) FROM sys_user expected_user INNER JOIN dept_position expected_scope ON expected_scope.dept_id = expected_user.dept_id AND expected_scope.position_id = c.position_id AND expected_scope.status = 1 WHERE expected_user.position_id = c.position_id AND expected_user.del_flag = '0' AND expected_user.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) AS expected_student_count, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(progress_record.progress, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT progress_user.user_id) * COUNT(DISTINCT progress_item.id), 0), 0) FROM sys_user progress_user INNER JOIN dept_position progress_scope ON progress_scope.dept_id = progress_user.dept_id AND progress_scope.position_id = c.position_id AND progress_scope.status = 1 CROSS JOIN study_item progress_item INNER JOIN course_chapter progress_chapter ON progress_chapter.id = progress_item.chapter_id AND progress_chapter.course_id = c.id AND progress_chapter.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN study_record progress_record ON progress_record.user_id = progress_user.user_id AND progress_record.course_id = c.id AND progress_record.item_id = progress_item.id WHERE progress_user.position_id = c.position_id AND progress_user.del_flag = '0' AND progress_user.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE') AND progress_item.deleted = 0 ), 0) AS avg_completion_rate
